U3-err-matter.agents_folder.en: This matter's folder holds a folder named ".agents", with instructions for AI tools. Clauseo doesn't let ChatGPT follow instructions kept in a matter's files. Rename or remove the ".agents" folder, and ChatGPT can work here.
